text: {"1098":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"The lint infrastructure uses future-incompatibility metadata to select diagnostics and lint-group membership."},"1099":{"about":["rustc_lint_defs"],"refers":[],"why":"The future-incompatibility reason and edition-lint classification are defined as lint metadata."},"1100":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"LintStore implements registration and placement of future-incompatible lints into lint groups."},"1101":{"about":["rustc_lint_defs"],"refers":[],"why":"The declare_lint! macro is defined by rustc_lint_defs and determines the supported declaration options."},"1102":{"about":["rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"The lint subsystem registers renamed or removed lints and emits warnings for their old names."}}
